notes:
Runbook-style notes from engagement:
- 2025-09-10 inbound via trial signup; product team (3 engineers, 2 PMs) evaluating chat + retrieval flows.
- 2025-10-02 discovery call (Maya) — want hosted first for fast time-to-value, plan to move to Dedicated once traffic stabilizes.
- 2025-11-15 demo: hosted_api end-to-end chat, embeddings for search. Positive on latency, flagged token costs at scale. Quote: 'we need predictable unit economics before committing.'
- 2026-01-25 cost-optimization workshop (Diego + Maya + eng leads). Focus: batching, prefix caching, and quantization tradeoffs. Actionable outcomes: suggested batching window 50-150ms for webchat; automatic prefix caching for FAQ-heavy flows; try 4-bit/8-bit mixed quant profiles on candidate models.
- Workshop artifacts: cost model spreadsheet (token mix, expected sessions/day), annotated trace showing KV cache hit-rates.
- POC plan: run 2-week Dedicated POC (reserved 4x A10G-like GPUs) with mirrors of production traffic (sampled). Goals: validate 95th-pctl chat latency <200ms, embeddings throughput 120-200 req/s, reduce per-token cost by 30% vs hosted baseline via batching & cache.
- Security: SSO/SAML required, KMS integration for key management, audit logs retention 365 days, data residency in us-east. Provided initial security FAQ and SOC2 attestation.
- Pricing convo: interested in blended committed rate for Dedicated + overflow on hosted_api. Finance expects ARR justification in Q2 2026.
- Open concerns: quantization QA for model hallucination risk, fallbacks when quantized variant fails quality checks, support SLA for POC.
- Quotes from eng lead: 'If we can hit 30% cost reduction without visible quality regression, we can push procurement.'
- Internal Redwood notes: prepare configuration template (batching windows, cache TTLs, quant profiles) and small eval harness to run automated QA on summaries/reranking.
- Recommended next actions: schedule 1-day on-site or remote POC kickoff, hand over sample traffic load map, gallery of prompts for quality guardrails.
- Staging: evaluation -> procurement if POC metrics pass.
